name: setLinesColor
description: Sets the color of asterism lines. Asterism lines connect stars to form recognizable patterns like the Summer Triangle or Big Dipper. The color is specified as an RGB vector with values between 0 and 1. Note: this setter does NOT save to settings — the change is lost on restart.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB color vector (R, G, B) where each component ranges from 0.0 to 1.0

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Not saved to settings. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesColor' (READ getLinesColor, WRITE setLinesColor).

name: getLinesColor
description: Returns the current color of asterism lines as an RGB vector. The result is a Vec3f and MUST be wrapped in new Color(...) before reading its components on Qt6.
returnDescription: RGB color vector (R, G, B) of the current line color (wrap in new Color(...) to inspect)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesColor'. IMPORTANT: core.getStelProperty('AsterismMgr.linesColor') returns a QVariant wrapping a Vec3f — wrap it in new Color(...) before reading components.

name: setRayHelpersColor
description: Sets the color of ray helpers — auxiliary lines that show extensions of asterism patterns or additional cultural connections between stars. Note: this setter does NOT save to settings — the change is lost on restart.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB color vector (R, G, B) with values between 0.0 and 1.0

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Not saved to settings. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersColor' (READ getRayHelpersColor, WRITE setRayHelpersColor).

name: getRayHelpersColor
description: Returns the current color of ray helper lines as an RGB vector. The result is a Vec3f and MUST be wrapped in new Color(...) before reading its components on Qt6.
returnDescription: RGB color vector (R, G, B) of the current ray helper color (wrap in new Color(...) to inspect)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersColor'. When read via core.getStelProperty, wrap in new Color(...).

name: setLabelsColor
description: Sets the color of asterism labels (names). Labels appear next to star patterns showing names like 'Summer Triangle', 'Big Dipper', or 'Northern Cross'. Note: this setter does NOT save to settings — the change is lost on restart.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB color vector (R, G, B) with values between 0.0 and 1.0

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Not saved to settings. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesColor' (READ getLabelsColor, WRITE setLabelsColor).

name: getLabelsColor
description: Returns the current color of asterism labels as an RGB vector. The result is a Vec3f and MUST be wrapped in new Color(...) before reading its components on Qt6.
returnDescription: RGB color vector (R, G, B) of the current label color (wrap in new Color(...) to inspect)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesColor'. When read via core.getStelProperty, wrap in new Color(...).

name: setFontSize
description: Sets the font size used for displaying asterism labels (names). Larger sizes make text more readable, smaller sizes reduce visual clutter. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: newFontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels (recommended range: 10 to 24)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Saved to viewing/asterism_font_size. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'fontSize'.

name: getFontSize
description: Returns the current font size for asterism labels in pixels.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'fontSize'.

example:
var fontSize = AsterismMgr.getFontSize();
core.debug("Label font size: " + fontSize + " px");

name: setAsterismLineThickness
description: Sets the thickness of asterism lines in pixels. Thicker lines are more visible, thinner lines look more elegant. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Saved to settings.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Saved to viewing/asterism_line_thickness. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'asterismLineThickness'.

name: getAsterismLineThickness
description: Returns the current thickness of asterism lines in pixels.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'asterismLineThickness'.

example:
var thickness = AsterismMgr.getAsterismLineThickness();
core.debug("Current line thickness: " + thickness);

name: setRayHelperThickness
description: Sets the thickness of ray helper lines in pixels. These auxiliary lines are typically thinner than main asterism lines. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Ray helper line thickness in pixels (minimum 1)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Saved to viewing/rayhelper_line_thickness. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelperThickness'.

name: getRayHelperThickness
description: Returns the current thickness of ray helper lines in pixels.
returnDescription: Ray helper line thickness in pixels

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelperThickness'.

example:
var rayThickness = AsterismMgr.getRayHelperThickness();
core.debug("Ray helper thickness: " + rayThickness + " px");

name: setFlagLines
description: Shows or hides asterism lines. When isolation mode is active and some asterisms are selected, this affects ONLY the selected asterisms; otherwise it affects all asterisms. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: displayed
parameters.description: true to show lines, false to hide them

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. When isolation mode is active with a non-empty selection, only selected asterisms are affected. Saved to viewing/flag_asterism_drawing. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesDisplayed'.

name: getFlagLines
description: Returns whether asterism lines are currently visible.
returnDescription: true if lines are visible, false if hidden

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesDisplayed'.

name: setFlagLabels
description: Shows or hides asterism labels (names). When isolation mode is active and some asterisms are selected, this affects ONLY the selected asterisms; otherwise it affects all asterisms. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: displayed
parameters.description: true to show labels, false to hide them

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. When isolation mode is active with a non-empty selection, only selected asterisms are affected. Saved to viewing/flag_asterism_name. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesDisplayed'.

name: getFlagLabels
description: Returns whether asterism labels are currently visible.
returnDescription: true if labels are visible, false if hidden

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesDisplayed'.

name: setFlagRayHelpers
description: Shows or hides ray helpers — auxiliary lines that show extensions of asterism patterns. Unlike setFlagLines/setFlagLabels, this affects ALL asterisms regardless of isolation mode. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: displayed
parameters.description: true to show ray helpers, false to hide them

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Always affects ALL asterisms (isolation mode does not restrict it). Saved to viewing/flag_rayhelper_drawing. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersDisplayed'.

name: getFlagRayHelpers
description: Returns whether ray helpers are currently visible.
returnDescription: true if ray helpers are visible, false if hidden

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersDisplayed'.

name: setLinesFadeDuration
description: Sets the fade duration for asterism lines when they appear or disappear. Controls how smoothly lines transition between visible and hidden states. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Fade duration in seconds (0 = instant, 1 = one second, 3 = slow fade)

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Saved to viewing/asterism_lines_fade_duration. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesFadeDuration'.

name: getLinesFadeDuration
description: Returns the current fade duration for asterism lines in seconds.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'linesFadeDuration'.

example:
var fadeTime = AsterismMgr.getLinesFadeDuration();
core.debug("Line fade duration: " + fadeTime + " s");

name: setLabelsFadeDuration
description: Sets the fade duration for asterism labels when they appear or disappear. Provides smooth transitions for label visibility changes. Saved to settings.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Saved to viewing/asterism_labels_fade_duration. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesFadeDuration'.

name: getLabelsFadeDuration
description: Returns the current fade duration for asterism labels in seconds.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'namesFadeDuration'.

example:
var labelFade = AsterismMgr.getLabelsFadeDuration();
core.debug("Label fade duration: " + labelFade + " s");

name: setRayHelpersFadeDuration
description: Sets the fade duration for ray helpers when they appear or disappear. Saved to settings.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Saved to viewing/rayhelper_lines_fade_duration. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersFadeDuration'.

name: getRayHelpersFadeDuration
description: Returns the current fade duration for ray helpers in seconds.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'rayHelpersFadeDuration'.

example:
var rayFade = AsterismMgr.getRayHelpersFadeDuration();
core.debug("Ray helpers fade duration: " + rayFade + " s");

name: selectAsterism
description: Selects an asterism by its English name. Automatically enables isolation mode if not already active, hiding all other asterisms. Case-insensitive match.

parameters.name: englishName
parameters.description: English name of the asterism (e.g., 'Summer Triangle', 'Big Dipper', 'Northern Cross', 'Winter Hexagon')

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Automatically enables isolation mode via setFlagIsolateAsterismSelected(true). If the name is not found, a debug message is printed.

name: deselectAsterism
description: Removes a specific asterism from the selected list. Automatically enables isolation mode if not already active. If this was the only selected asterism, all asterisms become hidden.

parameters.name: englishName
parameters.description: English name of the asterism to deselect

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Automatically enables isolation mode via setFlagIsolateAsterismSelected(true). When selection becomes empty, all asterisms are hidden.

name: deselectAsterisms
description: Deselects all asterisms. If isolation mode is active, all asterisms will be hidden. If isolation mode is not active, all asterisms will be restored to the standard flags.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0.

name: selectAllAsterisms
description: Selects all asterisms in the current sky culture. Useful for displaying all available star patterns at once. Note: uses setSelectedAsterism() internally, so if isolation mode is active, all asterisms are added to the selected list.

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Does not change isolation mode.

name: setFlagIsolateAsterismSelected
description: Enables or disables isolation mode for selected asterisms. When enabled, only selected asterisms are shown; all others are hidden. When disabled, all asterisms are restored to the standard lines/labels flags. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: isolate
parameters.description: true to enable isolation mode, false to disable

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Saved to viewing/flag_asterism_isolate_selected. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'isolateAsterismSelected'.

name: getFlagIsolateAsterismSelected
description: Returns whether isolation mode for selected asterisms is currently active.
returnDescription: true if isolation mode is active, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'isolateAsterismSelected'.

name: isLinesDefined
description: Checks whether asterism lines are defined in the current sky culture. Some cultures may not have asterisms, or may have different definitions.
returnDescription: true if asterisms exist in the current culture, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Available since 0.17.0. Not backed by Q_PROPERTY.
